name: Melody Bar & Grill
facts: Melody Bar & Grill, 9132 S Sepulveda Blvd, Los Angeles, CA 90045 (Westchester), since 1952, close to LAX.
Happy hour is 3–6 daily.
Mon: half off burgers 11–3. Tue: $4 tacos and $6 margaritas. Thu: half off sandwiches 11–3. Fri: $3 sliders 11–3.
Karaoke, live bands, DJs, trivia and every game on the TVs happen every week.
Rewards are free to join. Earn 10 points per $1 on eligible purchases, before tip.
Join bonus: +100 points once. Birthday: +250 once a year. Friend referral: +100 per friend who joins with your code and makes a first visit.
Rewards: 250 pts free soft drink or Melody Fries; 500 pts $10 off your check; 1,000 pts free starter; 1,500 pts free entrée up to $21.50.
One reward per visit, one prize per day, no stacking. Rewards have no cash value and are never free alcohol.
A reward pass works once and expires 10 minutes after you open it.
Just Landed: 10% off your first order today with a boarding pass from a flight that landed at LAX in the last 24 hours.
Melody Approach is a free flying game with Campaign (10 levels) and Survival modes.
Weekly boards (Campaign by score, Survival by longest time) reset every Monday.
The game's weekly prizes are in BETA and not switched on yet. The boards are for bragging rights for now.
Once game rewards are on: 1 point per 100 game score, up to 50 game points a day.
Games Pack: Trivia, Sports Trivia, Melody Word, Melody Mix, Truth or Dare, LA Scoreboard.
Games Pack points are capped at 10 a day and count toward the 50-a-day game limit.
Order from your phone by picking the bar, patio, to go or a table code, then pay your server like normal.
The app has 12 languages and needs no download.
Melody Rewards points are separate from Nalu Vida points.
Free parking at Melody. It's about a 15-minute walk from the LAX terminals.
LAX crew (airline, TSA, terminal, hotel and rental car workers) get 10% off the check with a badge, dine-in only.
Nearby alerts are optional, and the app only reads your location while it's open.

How do I play Melody Approach?
How do I order from my table?

qa.q: What is Melody Bar & Grill?
qa.a: Melody is a bar and grill in Westchester, the closest bar to LAX, open since 1952. This app has the menu, games, trivia and a free rewards club.

qa.q: Where are you located?
qa.a: 9132 S Sepulveda Blvd, Los Angeles, CA 90045 (Westchester). Tap Directions in the app for a map.

qa.q: What's your phone number?
qa.a: Call us at (310) 670-1994, or tap Call in the app.

qa.q: What are your hours?
qa.a: Our website lists Mon–Fri 11 AM to 1:30 AM and Sat–Sun 9 AM to 1:30 AM. Hours can vary, so call (310) 670-1994 to confirm late at night.

qa.q: When does the kitchen close?
qa.a: I don't have the kitchen's closing time. Please call (310) 670-1994 or ask staff.

qa.q: Is there parking?
qa.a: Yes, parking is free at Melody, including a free lot for people picking up travelers.

qa.q: Can I walk from LAX?
qa.a: Yes, it's about a 15-minute walk from the LAX terminals. Melody is also about 5 minutes from LAX by car.

qa.q: Do you take reservations?
qa.a: I don't have reservation details. Please call (310) 670-1994 to ask.

qa.q: Do you host private events or catering?
qa.a: Yes. Melody does private parties for roughly 10–150 guests, and there is a catering menu. Call (310) 670-1994 for details and pricing.

qa.q: Can I get delivery or takeout?
qa.a: Delivery is through DoorDash, and takeout is available. In the app you can also pick To go when you order.

qa.q: When is happy hour?
qa.a: Happy hour is 3–6 every day.

qa.q: What are the daily specials?
qa.a: Mon: half off burgers 11–3. Tue: $4 tacos (every taco) and $6 margaritas. Thu: half off sandwiches 11–3. Fri: $3 sliders 11–3.

qa.q: What's the Monday special?
qa.a: Half off burgers from 11 to 3.

qa.q: Is there a Taco Tuesday?
qa.a: Yes. Tuesdays are $4 for every taco on the menu and $6 margaritas.

qa.q: What's the Thursday special?
qa.a: Half off sandwiches from 11 to 3.

qa.q: What's the Friday special?
qa.a: $3 sliders from 11 to 3.

qa.q: Is there a Wednesday special?
qa.a: The app doesn't list a Wednesday special. Ask staff or call (310) 670-1994.

qa.q: Do you have karaoke, DJs or live music?
qa.a: Yes. Every week has karaoke, live bands, DJs and trivia, and every game is on the TVs. I don't have the exact days, so call (310) 670-1994 to ask.

qa.q: Can I watch the game at Melody?
qa.a: Yes, every game is on the TVs. The app's Today's games section shows live LA and California team scores and where to watch.

qa.q: Is there a cover charge?
qa.a: I don't have cover charge info. Please call (310) 670-1994 to ask.

qa.q: Is Melody kid friendly?
qa.a: I don't have our evening age policy. Please call (310) 670-1994 to ask before an after-dark visit.

qa.q: Is there a dress code?
qa.a: I don't have dress code info. Ask staff or call (310) 670-1994.

qa.q: Is there an LAX employee discount?
qa.a: Yes. Airline, TSA, terminal, hotel, rental car and shuttle workers get 10% off the check with a badge or proof of employment. It's dine-in only and can't be combined with other promos.

qa.q: What is Just Landed?
qa.a: If you landed at LAX in the last 24 hours, show your boarding pass for 10% off your first order today. It's one per guest per day and can't be combined with other offers.

qa.q: How do I use the Just Landed offer?
qa.a: Tap I just landed in the app to get your code, then show your boarding pass and the code to your server.

qa.q: How do I join Melody Rewards?
qa.a: Tap Join in the app. It's free, takes about 10 seconds, and you get a gold rewards card on your phone.

qa.q: Does it cost anything to join?
qa.a: No, joining is free. It's one account per person.

qa.q: Do I need to download an app?
qa.a: No download needed. It opens in your phone's browser, and you can add it to your home screen.

qa.q: How do I add the app to my home screen?
qa.a: Use your browser's Share or menu button and choose Add to Home Screen. On iPhone, nearby alerts only work once it's on your Home Screen (iOS 16.4 or newer).

qa.q: Can I add my card to Apple or Google Wallet?
qa.a: Not yet. The Apple and Google Wallet buttons aren't turned on. You can open your gold card any time under My Rewards Card in the app.

qa.q: How do I earn points?
qa.a: You earn 10 points for every $1 you spend on eligible purchases, before tip. You also get bonus points for joining, your birthday, referrals and the game.

qa.q: How many points per dollar?
qa.a: 10 points per $1 on eligible purchases, before tip.

qa.q: How do I get points for my visit?
qa.a: Tap Add my visit in the app and snap your receipt, or type the check number, total and date (today or yesterday). It's one receipt per day, each check counts once, and each check earns up to $150 worth of points.

qa.q: Are points checked?
qa.a: Yes. Claims are checked against the restaurant's sales report, and points from made-up checks are removed.

qa.q: Do I earn points on my tip?
qa.a: No. Points are 10 per $1 before tip.

qa.q: Do I earn points when I order from my phone?
qa.a: Yes. Members earn points on every check, including orders you send from the app.

qa.q: Is there a sign-up bonus?
qa.a: Yes, you get +100 points once when you join.

qa.q: How does the birthday bonus work?
qa.a: You get +250 points once a year on your birthday.

qa.q: Is there a birthday club or free birthday item?
qa.a: The birthday perk I have is +250 points once a year. I don't have any other birthday freebies, so ask staff.

qa.q: How do referrals work?
qa.a: Share your code. When a friend joins with it and makes a first visit, you get +100 points. Each friend can pay out once.

qa.q: How do I use a friend's referral code?
qa.a: Enter it once when you join. You can only use one friend's code, you can't change it later, and you can't use your own.

qa.q: Is there a location bonus?
qa.a: Yes. You get +100 points once if location and notifications are both on when you open the app on at least 3 different days spanning at least 7 days. It's added automatically and is optional.

qa.q: Is there a bonus for reviewing Melody?
qa.a: Yes, there's a one-time +50 points for telling us how we did in the app. A Google review link is also offered to everyone, with no points tied to it.

qa.q: Is there double points at happy hour?
qa.a: The app doesn't mention double points. Ask staff to confirm.

qa.q: Is there an early-bird bonus?
qa.a: I don't have an early-bird bonus. The bonuses I have are joining, birthday, referrals, the location bonus and game points.

qa.q: What rewards can I redeem?
qa.a: 250 pts: free soft drink or Melody Fries. 500 pts: $10 off your check. 1,000 pts: free starter (Fried Green Beans, Avocado Toast or Chicken Pot Stickers). 1,500 pts: a free entrée up to $21.50 (Mac & Cheese, Melody Burger, a burrito, tacos or Baby Back Ribs & Fries).

qa.q: How many points for a free drink or fries?
qa.a: 250 points gets you a free soft drink or Melody Fries.

qa.q: How many points for $10 off?
qa.a: 500 points gets you $10 off your check.

qa.q: How many points for a free starter?
qa.a: 1,000 points gets you a free starter: Fried Green Beans, Avocado Toast or Chicken Pot Stickers.

qa.q: How many points for a free entrée?
qa.a: 1,500 points gets you a free entrée up to $21.50. That covers Mac & Cheese, the Melody Burger, a burrito, tacos or Baby Back Ribs & Fries.

qa.q: How do I redeem a reward?
qa.a: Tap Use reward and show the live pass to your server, who applies it. Points come off when you open the pass.

qa.q: How long does a reward pass last?
qa.a: A pass works once and expires 10 minutes after you open it. Your next code comes on your next visit.

qa.q: Can I use more than one reward in a visit?
qa.a: No. It's one reward per visit, one prize per day, and rewards can't be stacked with other offers.

qa.q: Can I get a free drink with alcohol?
qa.a: No. Rewards are never free alcohol.

qa.q: What does "Come back tomorrow" mean?
qa.a: You've already used a prize today. That counts a reward, a gift or a game win. Your next prize is available tomorrow, by Los Angeles date.

qa.q: Can I give my points or rewards to someone else?
qa.a: No. Rewards have no cash value and can't be transferred.

qa.q: Do points expire?
qa.a: I don't have an expiry rule. Points you earn stay in your balance unless the program ends. Ask staff if you need more detail.

qa.q: Are there levels or tiers?
qa.a: I don't see levels or tiers in the app. You earn points and spend them on rewards.

qa.q: Do points work at Nalu Vida too?
qa.a: No. Each spot has its own balance, and Melody points don't move to Nalu Vida.

qa.q: What is Nalu Vida?
qa.a: It's our sister spot on the Venice Pier. Tap Surf over to Nalu Vida in the app to visit it.

qa.q: What is Melody Approach?
qa.a: It's a free flying arcade game in the app with two modes, Campaign and Survival. You fly a plane over LA, shoot enemies, dodge fire and catch Melody's food.

qa.q: How do I control the plane?
qa.a: Drag anywhere on the game and the plane glides to your finger. Tap ⚡ for a speed boost and grab the hourglass for slow-mo.

qa.q: What is Campaign mode?
qa.a: Campaign has 10 levels of about 45 seconds each over LA, getting a little harder each time. It has six boss fights, then you land at LAX.

qa.q: Which levels have bosses?
qa.a: Levels 3, 5, 6, 7, 8 and 10 have boss fights.

qa.q: What is Survival mode?
qa.a: There's no finish line, and the game keeps getting harder until your plane goes down. Your time survived is your score.

qa.q: How does damage work in the game?
qa.a: Every enemy attack is warned first. Three hits and your plane goes down, and the game is over.

qa.q: When can I shoot?
qa.a: Guns go live about 20 seconds into a flight. Beating levels and bosses (or flying longer in Survival) unlocks stronger guns, and ammo crates refill them.

qa.q: Can I play without fighting?
qa.a: Yes. Tap the ⚔️ button in Pause to switch to a calm flight with no combat.

qa.q: How much does it cost to play, and how often can I play?
qa.a: It's free, with or without an account, and no purchase is needed. I don't see a limit on how often you can fly.

qa.q: How do I get on the weekly leaderboard?
qa.a: After a flight, tap Post my score. Campaign is ranked by score and Survival by the longest time survived. Practice and test flights don't count.

qa.q: When does the leaderboard reset?
qa.a: Both boards reset every Monday.

qa.q: Are there game prizes right now?
qa.a: Not yet. The weekly prizes are in BETA and will switch on soon. The boards are live now for bragging rights only.

qa.q: What can I win from the weekly game?
qa.a: Once rewards are switched on, the top player on each weekly board may win the weekly prize shown in the game, for example free Melody Fries. Ask staff how winners are contacted and when prizes are picked up, since I don't have those details.

qa.q: How many points do I get from the game?
qa.a: Once game rewards are on, you get 1 point per 100 score, up to 50 game points a day. Right now they're off, so the game gives no points.

qa.q: What is the Games Pack?
qa.a: It's Trivia, Sports Trivia, Melody Word, Melody Mix, Truth or Dare and the LA Scoreboard. You can play solo or pass the phone around the table.

qa.q: How does Trivia work?
qa.a: You get timed multiple-choice questions on music, food and drink, pop culture and LA. Faster right answers score more. Play solo for 10 questions, or pass the phone with 2–6 players.

qa.q: How does Sports Trivia work?
qa.a: Pick a team for a 10-question Fan Test and get a 1–5 star Fan Rating, or play mixed LA sports questions. It's the same timed format as Trivia.

qa.q: What is Melody Word?
qa.a: It's one daily 5-letter word, the same for everyone. You get 6 guesses and up to 2 hints, and a new word arrives every midnight LA time.

qa.q: What is Melody Mix?
qa.a: It's a word scramble. Unscramble as many words as you can before time runs out, and you get 3 skips.

qa.q: How does Truth or Dare work?
qa.a: It's a table game for 1–6 players with 3 turns each. Pick a light truth or a fun dare, and anyone can pass. Dares never involve drinking.

qa.q: Do trivia and word games give points?
qa.a: Once game rewards are on: Trivia and Sports Trivia give 1 point per 2 right answers (up to 5 a round). Melody Mix gives 1 point per 2 words (up to 3). The daily Melody Word gives 3 points, or 2 with one hint and 1 with two hints. They're off in BETA right now.

qa.q: Is there a daily limit on Games Pack points?
qa.a: Yes, 10 Games Pack points a day per member and phone, counted toward the 50-a-day game limit. Truth or Dare gives no points.

qa.q: What is the LA Scoreboard and "Who wins?"
qa.a: The LA Scoreboard shows live scores from ESPN for information only, with no streams. "Who wins?" picks are free and just for fun, with no money or wagers, and they lock when the game starts.

qa.q: Are there Football Squares?
qa.a: Per the rules, every member can get one free square per NFL or college game board with Get my free square. Extra squares come with purchase through staff, and prizes are shown on the board before you play. Ask staff if a board is running.

qa.q: How do I order from my table?
qa.a: Scan your table's QR code, or pick Bar, Patio or To go in the app. Add items, tap Send my order, then pay your server or bartender like normal.

qa.q: What do I do if I didn't scan a table code?
qa.a: Pick where you're sitting (a table number, the bar, the patio or to go) in the app before you send your order.

qa.q: How do I pay?
qa.a: Pay your server or bartender like normal. You still earn points on every check.

qa.q: What's on the menu?
qa.a: Food categories are Starters, Mac & Cheese, Burgers, Fries, Soups, and Tacos & Burritos. There's also a drinks list. Browse them in the app.

qa.q: What Mac & Cheese do you have?
qa.a: House Mac $15, Bacon Cheddar & Jalapeño $17.25, Parmesan & Mushroom $17.25, Chicken Parmesan $18.25, Melody Burger Mac $19.25 and Lobster $21.50.

qa.q: What starters do you have?
qa.a: Lemon Pepper Wings $16, Avocado Toast $13, BBQ Rib Grilled Cheese Bites $15, Buttermilk Chicken Strips & Fries $16, Chicken Pot Stickers $15, Fried Green Beans $13, Fried Shrimp $18.25, Jalapeño Calamari $16, Lettuce Wraps $16 and Baby Back Ribs & Fries $20.25.

qa.q: What tacos and burritos do you have?
qa.a: Tacos come two to an order: Shrimp $16, Salmon $16, Carnitas $14, Chicken $13, Avocado $13 and Beyond $14. Burritos: Carnitas $18.25, Steak $18.25, Chicken $17.25, Bean & Cheese $14. There are also Nachos $15 and a Cheese Quesadilla $15.

qa.q: What fries and soups do you have?
qa.a: Fries: Gilroy Garlic $6.75, Melody $5.75, Onion Strings $9.75, Phat $7.75, Philly Cheese Steak $17.25 and Sweet Potato $7.75. Soups: French Onion, Tomato Bisque and Black Bean, in a cup or bowl.

qa.q: Tell me about the Melody Burger.
qa.a: It's Angus beef on a pretzel bun with caramelized onions, Gorgonzola, apple-smoked bacon, spinach and BBQ sauce, served with fries, for $19.25.

qa.q: What drinks do you have?
qa.a: The app lists Mango Margarita, House Margarita, Paloma, Old Fashioned, Moscow Mule, Espresso Martini, Long Island, Michelada, Draft Beer, Mimosa, shots and a bucket of 5 beers. Drink prices in the app are previews, so ask your server for current prices.

qa.q: Do you have vegan or vegetarian options?
qa.a: Yes. The app lists Avocado Tacos, Beyond Tacos, a Bean & Cheese Burrito, Avocado Toast, Fried Green Beans and Black Bean Soup. Ask your server about ingredients.

qa.q: Can I get Fries added with cheese?
qa.a: Yes. Melody Fries and Phat Fries can add cheese for +$2.

qa.q: What languages is the app in?
qa.a: The app has 12 languages.

qa.q: Is there a kid mode?
qa.a: The Games Pack can hide adult-only games in kid mode, but I don't have the full kid mode rules. Ask staff.

qa.q: What does the app know about my location?
qa.a: Only if you turn on nearby alerts, and only while the app is open. It shows a You're nearby deal within about half a mile of Melody. Your exact location stays on your phone, and it's never sold or used for ads.

qa.q: How do I turn off nearby alerts?
qa.a: Tap Turn off nearby alerts in the app, or switch off Location and Notifications for the app in your phone's Settings. Points you've earned stay.

qa.q: What does the app record when I open it?
qa.a: At most once every 10 minutes it records the time, a short device summary, whether you opened it from your Home Screen, a random phone ID and your member ID. Only Melody's owner and SousShift AI see it, and it's never sold or used for ads.

qa.q: Do I need an account to play the games?
qa.a: No, the games are free with or without an account. An account lets you save game points once rewards are on.

qa.q: How do I get help from staff?
qa.a: Ask your server or bartender, or call (310) 670-1994.

qa.q: Can the rewards program change?
qa.a: Yes. Melody can change or end the program, point values or rewards with notice in the app. Points you've already earned stay in your balance unless the program ends.
